scope: Small private HTTP2 follow-up; no current-HEAD whole rebuild or elapsed benchmark
changes: Remove private submit_epoch and its 11 write-only increment sites; change_epoch and all encoded/flushed epochs retain their original meaning.
Use uninitialized local arrays for at most 8 total outbound NV entries including pseudo-headers and generated content-length; larger heads retain the existing NvArray heap owner and error cleanup.

native_contract.headers: Pinned nghttp2.h:4547-4552,4690-4695 describes copying normal NV name/value pairs at submit.
native_contract.implementation: Pinned lib/nghttp2_submit.c:123 invokes nghttp2_nv_array_copy before submit_headers_shared.
native_contract.flags: make_nv retains NGHTTP2_NV_FLAG_NONE. No NO_COPY_NAME/NO_COPY_VALUE or persistent trailer changes.

mechanical_effect: The original 4-stream fixed-body episode submits 4 request heads and 4 response heads with 5/2 NV entries: these 8 temporary descriptor allocation/free pairs disappear. This is a source-derived call reduction, not measured total allocations/RSS or a timing speedup.
tests: Existing small/multiplexed/trailer/borrow/cancel/OOM/flow-control/GOAWAY cases plus one new large request/response (9 NV each), complete header/body bytes and view-lifetime regression. Default and epoll each 16/16 pass.
not_measured: elapsed performance or restored manual-loop parity
sanitizers or forced large-header allocation failure matrix
future_candidate: active_protocol_streams rescans retained streams during drain/GOAWAY readiness; not changed in this patch and not on the old fixed-body holdout hot path.
